question: ip-proxy/trust-zone-exits says trial-only; ip-proxy/trust-zone says paid-only. Which holds?
why: https://trust.zone/prices lists paid plans ($39.99 billed annually, $9.99 billed monthly) beside a 3-day no-card trial capped at 1,000 claims a month, so paid-only holds and trial-only ignores the paid plans.
